title: ADHD, Autism & Neurodivergent Experience
description: Explore neurodiversity as population variation through dialogue, evidence and psychological reasoning.

nodes.title: An idea worth carrying forward
nodes.body:
Neurodiversity describes variation across a population. An individual's neurotype may inform support needs, but meaningful functioning emerges from the interaction between person and environment.

Neurodivergence, a formal diagnosis and disability are related but distinct concepts. A population-level idea cannot be used to infer one person's traits.

The purpose of the exercise is to make a better-supported judgement and choose a proportionate next step.
